text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm back~
...Wait, huh—?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Is she folding paper cranes...?
...Even so, she looks awfully serious about it.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Believe-san. She's putting so much thought
into the colors, yet works so fast... But still—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...—Still far from a thousand. I suppose she's
being extra careful since it's a gift for someone, but—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...—I'd like to help if I can. But...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, are you making a thousand paper cranes?
Can I help out too?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm alright.
This is my job, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I will see it through responsibly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Even if I offer to help, I can already see her turning me down! You don't get things this obvious very often!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Still—...we can't just leave it like this.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Believe-san.
Could I have a sheet of origami paper too?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
?
...Yes, I don't mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch!
I felt like foldin' a crane too.
Watchin' you made me wanna try it again after so long.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"So... could ya teach me how ya folded it?
Honest, I couldn't take my eyes off it,
it was folded so real pretty."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...We both made quite a lot, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Aye, my shoulders were killin' me—
—wait, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"There's something I'd love Believe-san to try.
The timing's just right, too."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—...So sweet.
Thank you... for sharing the brown sugar candy with me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I just thought
it'd be a good way to refresh ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............
――That's true, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, I feel like I can finally catch my breath.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please eat up.
Why, we've got plenty to go around.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But with this much—
I feel bad taking it all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it at all. This old lady sees it all~
I always see how hard you're working, Lala-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Still, you have a tendency to overdo it, don't you?
That's why I want you to take a break with some sweets now and then.
I want you to stay healthy forever, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I thought they were fruit-flavored candies or something, but every single one was brown sugar candy...
Man, they were just so, so sweet.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is strangely effective for fatigue.
...Don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Lara-san.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...A thousand paper cranes.
Actually... it's a get-well gift.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
! So that's why you were...
Did someone get hospitalized?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's someone named Masahiko-san whom I often run into
during my jogs.
He's always... cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering why I hadn't seen them around lately...
Apparently, they slipped and took a fall at home.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It seems it wasn't anything too serious, but—
well, I want to send her a thousand paper cranes as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ! ...I see. If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Would you like to have this crane
I folded just for fun?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's what happened.
I guess that's about all that's happened recently.”
choice_data_list: So, how did it turn out?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That is just...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Miss Lala,
everyone loved the beautiful thousand paper cranes.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No. Isn't it just because Believe-san explained it so thoroughly?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No... I couldn't have achieved this alone.
Besides, um—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Working with Lala-san was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She might be clumsy... but she's straightforward and honest to a fault.
—She really is someone who puts others first. Fufu.
choice_data_list: They really accepted your feelings, didn't they?
They accepted your feelings, didn't they?
If you'd told me, I would've helped too.
If you'd told me, I would've helped too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She might be clumsy... but she's straightforward and honest to a fault.
—She really is someone who puts others first. Fufu.
choice_data_list: They really accepted your feelings, didn't they?
They accepted your feelings, didn't they?
If you'd told me, I would've helped too.
If you'd told me, I would've helped too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
After all, she's not the type of person to brush aside people's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh, bold words! It's going to be quite tough, you know?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course.
...It was so tough, I could never forget it.
